selector.champion: Progressive Ataxia and Palatal Tremor (PAPT), sporadic type
selector.rationale: The patient's 20-year history of progressive ataxia and palatal myoclonus, along with severe cerebral and cerebellar atrophy, best supports PAPT, sporadic type, as it explains both the ataxia and the palatal myoclonus without contradiction.

rejected.label: Spinocerebellar Ataxia
rejected.why: Genetic testing for common types was normal

rejected.label: Alcoholic cerebellar ataxia
rejected.why: Difficulty with gait progressed after cessation of alcohol use

rejected.label: Multiple system atrophy
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for autonomic dysfunction or other system involvement

rejected.label: Parkinsonian Syndrome
rejected.why: While bradykinesia and mild rigidity are present, they are not the primary features
